response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile software engineer with real geospatial GIS experience (GISCollective, Green Map) and some low-level C/C++ background, but his recent career has shifted heavily toward TypeScript/Node.js full-stack and web work, with minimal current C++/Rust usage and no evident distributed-systems or routing-tile pipeline experience.
strengths: Genuine geospatial/GIS domain experience through GISCollective and Green Map projects
Broad technical range including C/C++ (National Instruments) and systems-level D language work (async I/O, fibers, high-performance services)
Strong self-learner with demonstrated ability to pick up new stacks and mentor others (workshops, talks, TDD advocacy)
concerns: C++ experience is dated (2014-2015) and not a primary recent skill; current listed skills omit C++/Rust entirely
No explicit experience with routing engines, navigation guidance systems, or traffic-data integration
Limited demonstrated exposure to distributed-systems concepts like fault tolerance, consistency, and service discovery at scale

key_factors.factor: Lack of recent/primary C++ or Rust expertise
